name: Life spaceship 119e5cea on 2-uniform tiling k2-011
description: A period-3 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 2-uniform tiling k2-011, with touching neighbours, 9 to 11 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12. It also runs in Life, unchanged, on k3-002. JETCARP's Life census met it in 329 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
